And if you want a reason to get out and about, the Snellville Fall Festival is coming up this weekend. As always, I am glad you are here.

market.title: Gwinnett County: September 2026 at a glance
market.source: Realtor.com Economic Research county inventory data
paragraphs: Sellers in Gwinnett County added 1,126 new listings in September 2026, 5.6% more new listings than a year earlier, while 969 homes were pending.
The simple version for Gwinnett: buyers have more homes to compare than they did a year ago, so pricing and condition matter more than ever.

rotatingFeatures.label: HOMEOWNER / SEASONAL HOME TIP
rotatingFeatures.title: Check the Fireplace Before the First Fire of the Season
rotatingFeatures.topic: a fireplace and chimney check before the first fire
paragraphs: Before the first cozy fire, open the damper, look up with a flashlight, and make sure nothing obvious is blocking the flue. The U.S. Fire Administration recommends having heating equipment and chimneys cleaned and inspected by a professional each year.
items: Confirm the damper opens and closes fully.
Clear the hearth area; keep anything that can burn at least 3 feet away.
Schedule the yearly chimney cleaning and inspection if it is due.
rotatingFeatures.closing: A quick look now beats a smoky living room on the first chilly Friday night.
rotatingFeatures.source: Source: U.S. Fire Administration, Heating Fire Safety.

rotatingFeatures.label: LOCAL COMMUNITY EVENT
rotatingFeatures.title: 17th Annual Snellville Fall Festival
rotatingFeatures.availability: Saturday, October 24, 2026, 12-6 PM; free to attend
paragraphs: Snellville's fall festival is free to attend, with craft and food vendors, live music, pumpkin decorating, and costume contests for all ages, including dogs.
A Kids Zone armband covers the rock wall, mini golf, trackless train, and inflatables.
rotatingFeatures.closing: 2342 Oak Road, Snellville. The city lists the Kids Zone armband at $15 and pumpkin decorating at $2.
rotatingFeatures.source: Source: Experience Snellville, Fall Festival event page.
